title: Count-From Date for the Closing Contact (Occupancy and Residency Certification)
content:
Scheduled contacts for the closing contact of a health-care absence on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile are counted from the **count-from date**:

| Records | Count-from date |
|---|---|
| a check-in is recorded on the profile | the date of the latest recorded check-in (the check-in on the profile with the latest date) |
| no check-in is recorded, and the borrower's absence notice was received more than 45 calendar days after the absence start date (the schedule could be followed only from then) | the date that notice was received |
| every other case | the absence start date |

The borrower's absence notice is the accepted health-care absence notice about the primary borrower received most recently, with the date it was received; where none is on file, the absence start date stands in for that date.

*Boundary (hypothetical).* With no check-in recorded, a notice received 45 days after the absence start date leaves the count-from date at the absence start date; at 46 days it moves to the receipt date.
